p.i: Dei contra peccata hominum colligere & obseruare debent: cum tanta seueritate in electis suis, corruptam naturam, & minora etiam peccata puniat, quid de illis fiet? Hæ ferè sunt causæ, ob quas Deus pios homines fame, priuatis publicisq; calamitatibus inuoluat & exerceat. Sed hæc de finalibus causis annnotasse sufficiant. Orandus Deus ut in hac cruce veram patientiam largiatur. Illi debetur benedictio, gloria & potestas in æ-ternum. Amen.

main_text.head: CONCIO III.
QVO PACTO TAM DIVITES quàm pauperes se famis tem-pores gerere debeant.
main_text.p: UT peritus medicus primo causas & grauitatem morbi ægro osten-dit, dein quid ei facto opus sit præscribit, & medicinam adhibet: Eadem in cõmuni hoc quasi morbo, publica scilicet re-rum omnium penuria & fame, spirituali me

page.notes: The initial V is a woodcut letter, joined to the word as "UT". Printed "annnotasse" has a doubled n as printed. The first paragraph is set entirely in italic. The catchword "dico" is at the lower right. No page number, signature or marginal notes are printed on this page.
